$schema_note: Single source of truth for EB-5 risk scoring. Read by skills/eb5-scoring/SKILL.md (to compute) and scripts/render_report.ps1 (to render). Scores are 0 = lowest risk (best) .. 100 = highest risk (worst).

confidence_scale.3: High — primary government or court record (USCIS RC list/termination, I-956F notice, SEC EDGAR filing, PACER docket).
confidence_scale.2: Medium — reputable independent third party (established trade press, independent market data, county recorder, third-party audited financials).
confidence_scale.1: Low — single uncorroborated weak third-party source, or issuer doc corroborated by one weak signal.
confidence_scale.0: None — only the issuer's own marketing/PPM, or nothing at all. Claim is UNVERIFIABLE.

verdict_credit_rule: A claim may only earn confidence >= 2 (and a non-penalized sub-score) if corroborated by a NON-ISSUER source of tier >= 2. The issuer corroborating itself does not count. Otherwise the claim is downgraded to UNVERIFIABLE (confidence 0).

immigration_factors.name: Regional Center good standing
immigration_factors.good: Active and in good standing on the USCIS approved RC list.
immigration_factors.primary_source: USCIS approved RC list + termination list

immigration_factors.name: Job-creation methodology & cushion
immigration_factors.good: Job count independently re-derived (eligible spend x regional multiplier, land excluded, deflated); >=30-50% cushion above 10 jobs/investor; RIA indirect caps (90%, or 75% if construction <2 years) and the 2-year construction-duration rule satisfied with margin; allocation order defined.
immigration_factors.bad: Count not reproducible, land/financing in modeled spend, wrong-region or inflated multipliers, construction schedule near/under 24 months with direct construction jobs counted, indirect share at/over the RIA cap, relocated or tenant jobs counted, thin/zero cushion.
immigration_factors.primary_source: Economic report re-derived vs independent BEA/BLS multipliers and contractor/permit schedule evidence

immigration_factors.name: TEA / set-aside qualification validity
immigration_factors.good: Rural / high-unemployment / infrastructure set-aside independently confirmed (Census/BLS/USCIS designation).
immigration_factors.bad: Gerrymandered or expired designation, or unverifiable.
immigration_factors.primary_source: Census ACS, BLS LAUS, USCIS TEA guidance

immigration_factors.name: Sustainment / at-risk 2-yr rule (RIA)
immigration_factors.good: Capital deployed and sustained >=2 years from investment per RIA; clear at-risk structure.
immigration_factors.bad: Ambiguous deployment timing or early-return features that break at-risk.
immigration_factors.primary_source: PPM terms re-checked vs RIA; deployment evidence

immigration_factors.name: Redeployment terms
immigration_factors.good: Same-RC, NCE-consistent, geographically permissible redeployment with investor protections.

immigration_factors.name: I-526E / I-829 approval track record
immigration_factors.good: RC/sponsor has prior I-829 (conditions removed) approvals.
immigration_factors.bad: No track record or a pattern of prior denials/RFEs.

immigration_factors.name: RIA compliance: fund admin, audits, securities
immigration_factors.good: Independent fund administrator + annual audit + I-956G filings + securities compliance.
immigration_factors.bad: No fund admin, no audit, securities red flags.

immigration_factors.name: Source-of-funds independence / integrity
immigration_factors.good: Standard, well-documented SOF pathway; no sanctioned jurisdictions.
immigration_factors.bad: Opaque/structured SOF guidance from the issuer.
immigration_factors.primary_source: Issuer SOF guidance vs sanctions/AML norms

financial_factors.name: Capital-stack position & EB-5 %
financial_factors.good: EB-5 is a modest slice with senior debt and meaningful sponsor equity; EB-5 is not the first-loss tranche.
financial_factors.bad: EB-5 is the de-facto equity / first-loss and >50% of the stack.
financial_factors.primary_source: PPM/I-526E cap table vs title/lender records

financial_factors.name: Loan vs equity model & terms
financial_factors.good: Senior or well-secured loan, market rate, clear maturity.
financial_factors.bad: Unsecured/subordinated equity with no defined exit.

financial_factors.name: Collateral & guarantees
financial_factors.good: Recorded first-lien collateral; completion + repayment guarantees from a creditworthy guarantor.
financial_factors.bad: Unsecured, no guarantee, or guarantor is the same shell.

financial_factors.name: Developer track record & balance sheet
financial_factors.good: Long completed-project history, audited balance sheet, no defaults.
financial_factors.bad: First-timer, prior defaults/bankruptcies, thin balance sheet.

financial_factors.name: Construction / completion risk
financial_factors.good: Permitted, GMP contract, bonded GC, low entitlement risk.
financial_factors.bad: Pre-entitlement, no permits, single-source GC, cost-overrun exposure.

financial_factors.name: Market / demand risk
financial_factors.good: Independent market study supports absorption/occupancy; diversified demand.
financial_factors.bad: Speculative demand, single tenant, oversupplied submarket.
financial_factors.primary_source: Independent market data vs issuer study

financial_factors.name: Repayment / takeout source
financial_factors.good: Identified takeout (refi/sale) with conservative LTV and DSCR.
financial_factors.bad: 'We'll refinance later' with no committed takeout.

financial_factors.name: Escrow & redeployment (financial)
financial_factors.good: Funds in escrow until I-526E/material milestone; conservative redeployment.
financial_factors.bad: Funds released immediately to sponsor; aggressive redeployment.

financial_factors.name: Fees & conflicts of interest
financial_factors.good: Arm's-length, disclosed, market fees; no self-dealing.
financial_factors.bad: Stacked admin/origination/management fees to affiliates; related-party leases.

financial_factors.name: Return-of-capital / distribution history
financial_factors.good: Sponsor has returned EB-5 capital on prior deals.
financial_factors.bad: No returns yet, or capital stuck in redeployment loops.

uncertainty_surcharge.explanation: Computed separately for the immigration factors and the financial factors using that score's average per-factor confidence. Added to the weighted composite. This is the 'do not trust issuer paper' penalty.

verdict.priority: Immigration de-risking is the PRIMARY objective (protecting the green card); financial risk is SECONDARY (protecting capital). The immigration band gates the verdict: financial risk ALONE never forces a NO-GO when immigration risk is low. Immigration risk that is high is always a NO-GO.
verdict.ranking: In a comparison, rank projects by the immigration composite FIRST (lower = better), then by the financial composite as the tiebreaker. Surface the most immigration-de-risked deals at the top of the one-pager and matrix.
verdict.matrix_note: Immigration-primary. imm_low + fin_high = CONDITIONAL (not NO-GO): a project whose immigration is strongly de-risked is never sunk by financial risk alone — it is flagged CONDITIONAL with the financial issues listed as conditions_to_clear. imm_high stays NO-GO across the row because immigration is the priority.

confidence_floor.effect: If overall average confidence < 1.5, the verdict is capped at CONDITIONAL and a 'verdict limited by data gaps' banner is shown.

verdict.conditional_requirement: Every CONDITIONAL verdict must enumerate the specific conditions that would move it to GO.

g4_evidence_standard: G4 requires AFFIRMATIVE DISPROOF, not an unresolved gap. Enumerate the full bounded grouping universe (site tract + directly adjacent tracts) on the ACS vintage current at the I-956F filing date and show the MAXIMUM falls short. Could-not-reproduce is a data gap; clears-only-on-corner-point-adjacency or a post-filing vintage is fragile, not a gate. See skills/eb5-tea-hua/SKILL.md.

hard_gates.gate_class_note: Nothing the investor or sponsor can do inside a decision window.
hard_gates.name: RC terminated or debarred
hard_gates.trigger: Regional center appears on the USCIS termination list or principals are debarred.

hard_gates.gate_class_note: A refiling is a new project on a new clock, not a cure for this decision.
hard_gates.name: I-956F denied or withdrawn
hard_gates.trigger: The project's I-956F was denied or withdrawn.

hard_gates.gate_class_note: Goes to the principals, not the paperwork.
hard_gates.name: SEC / fraud enforcement vs principals
hard_gates.trigger: An SEC enforcement action, fraud injunction, or criminal action against the principals/sponsor.

hard_gates.gate_class_note: The $800,000 price is fixed by the record as of filing and cannot be repaired retroactively; an amended/refiled I-956F on a valid basis resets the clock (a different deal, not a cure).
hard_gates.name: Proven TEA / set-aside misqualification
hard_gates.trigger: The reserved-category set-aside is provably invalid or expired.

hard_gates.gate_class_note: Classify as G5-doc (a document was mischaracterised - potentially curable, the sponsor can produce the real document) or G5-fact (a state of the world was misstated - not curable by explanation). Curability never promotes the verdict; a fired gate is always NO-GO.
hard_gates.name: Confirmed material misrepresentation
hard_gates.trigger: A material claim is CONTRADICTED and the adversarial pass confirms it with a second independent source.

risk_calibration.note: Advisory OVERLAY, never an override. It does not change any subscore, composite, or gate verdict; a fired hard gate always keeps the verdict at NO-GO. Full method in skills/eb5-risk-calibration/SKILL.md. Purpose: every real EB-5 offering has defects, so separate the few findings that should stop a decision from the many that should be noted and moved past.

probability_bands.P4: >80% near-certain - already true on the record, not a forecast
probability_bands.P2: 20-50% realistic - a regularly observed failure mode for this structure
probability_bands.P1: 5-20% unlikely - needs an additional adverse event

risk_calibration.probability_basis_rule: Anchor each band to a cited base rate where one exists (USCIS I-526E/I-956F outcomes, RC terminations vs approvals, processing times). Where none exists, record basis='judgment - no published base rate'. An uncited band must be visibly an estimate.
risk_calibration.data_gap_vs_defect: Ask whether evidence would exist if the claim were true. Probative absence (no I-797C for a claimed approval; no permits for a project marketed as under construction) is scored. Non-probative absence (no Form D where Reg S/506(b) applies; no third-party guaranty, which most EB-5 deals lack) is not a finding.

severity_classes.S4: Green-card fatal or total loss of the $800,000
severity_classes.S3: Severe - RFE/NOID with real denial risk, multi-year delay, or majority capital loss
severity_classes.S2: Moderate - recoverable delay, redeployment, or partial impairment
severity_classes.S1: Minor - cost or friction only; does not change the outcome

dispositions.ACCEPT: Note it and move on. This finding must NOT be allowed to delay the decision - say so in the report.
dispositions.CAUTION: Proceed, but complete one named check that can actually be finished before wiring.
dispositions.MITIGATE: Proceed only on obtaining a specific written change or document. A refusal to put in writing something asserted verbally is itself a finding and normally raises the probability band by one.

risk_calibration.mitigation_rule: Every CAUTION/MITIGATE must carry a concrete mitigation obtainable by an individual investor before closing. 'Ask the sponsor to be more transparent' is not a mitigation; 'require escrow release on I-526E approval rather than filing' is.
irreducible_verification_set: Regional center on the live USCIS approved list, absent from terminations, approved for the project's STATE, matched by RC ID (not name)
The actual I-797C receipt/approval notice for the I-956F - read the notice, not the representation about it
TEA re-derived from the JCE's RECORDED PARCEL (never a geocoded address or intersection)
Escrow: which event releases the money - filing vs approval are different products at the same price
Capital stack: does sources = uses, who sits ahead of the EB-5 money, and what happens if the raise is not completed
Job cushion at the ACTUAL investor count, with the statutory indirect cap and construction-duration proration applied
risk_calibration.time_pressure_protocol: When the user states a deadline or asks for a realistic read: complete the irreducible set; state which findings must not delay the decision; rank by RESIDUAL risk (after obtainable mitigations) alongside the raw immigration-first ranking whenever the two differ; and state plainly what cannot be resolved before the deadline and what proceeding accepts. Realism sizes survivable problems - it never softens a structural gate. If every candidate is AVOID, the honest output is 'none of these'.
risk_calibration.residual_verdict_rule: residual_verdict may differ from verdict only by being WORSE, or by moving within the CONDITIONAL band once mitigations are applied. A fired hard gate always keeps verdict at NO-GO; express curability via gate_class, never by promoting the verdict.
